scripts.dev: npm run infra && npm run migrate && concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,yellow,magenta "npm:api" "npm:worker" "npm:web"
scripts.dev:lan: npm run infra && npm run migrate && concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,yellow,magenta "npm:api" "npm:worker" "npm:web:lan"
scripts.worker: cd backend && .venv/bin/watchfiles --filter python '.venv/bin/celery -A app.worker.celery_app worker -B --loglevel=INFO' app
scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
